IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROVIDE LEADERSHIP & LOCAL ADVOCACY FOR MEMBER HOSPITALS IN THE SAN DIEGO & IMPERIAL COUNTIES.
IRS990.MissionDesc: HOSPITAL ASSOCIATION'S MISSION IS TO SUPPORT ITS HOSPITALS & HOSPITAL SYSTEM MEMBERS BY ADVANCING THE ORGANIZATION, MANAGEMENT AND EFFECTIVE DELIVERY OF AFFORDABLE, MEDICALLY NECESSARY, QUALITY HEALTHCARE SERVICES FOR THE SAN DIEGO AND IMPERIAL COUNTY COMMUNITIES. HASDIC PROVIDES STRONG LEADERSHIP, REPRESENTATION AND ADVOCACY WITH LOCAL ORGANIZATIONS AND THE PUBLIC.
IRS990.Desc: COMMUNITY HEALTH NEEDS ASSESSMENT (CHNA) IS A PROJECT WHICH AIMS TO PROVIDE HASDIC WITH INFORMATION FOR ITS MEMBER HOSPITALS, ENABLING THEM TO USE AND TO DESCRIBE THE COMMUNITY HEALTH NEEDS OF SAN DIEGO COUNTY RESIDENTS PAYING ATTENTION TO HEALTH DISPARITIES BY GEOGRAPHY, RACE/ETHNICITY, INSURANCE STATUS AND OTHER FACTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ASSOCIATION IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)(6) AND CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAX CODE SECTION 23701E. THE FOUNDATION IS A NONPROFIT PUBLIC BENEFIT CORPORATION AND IS EXEMPT FROM TAXES UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)(3) AND CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAX CODE SECTION 23701D. THEY ARE, HOWEVER, SUBJECT TO INCOME TAXES FROM ACTIVITIES UNRELATED TO THEIR TAX-EXEMPT PURPOSE. MANAGEMENT DOES NOT BELIEVE THERE IS ANY UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023. IN THE EVENT THE ASSOCIATION HAD A TAX PROVISION THAT WAS UNCERTAIN OF BEING SUSTAINED, THE ASSOCIATION WOULD APPLY THE MINIMUM PROBABILITY THRESHOLD TO DETERMINE WHETHER A FINANCIAL STATEMENT LIABILITY OR BENEFIT SHOULD BE RECOGNIZED. THERE WERE NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023.

THE ORGANIZATION MAINTAINS A NON-QUALIFIED SUPPLEMENTAL RETIREMENT PLAN. THIS PLAN IS INTENDED TO QUALIFY AS AN UNFUNDED PLAN OF DEFERRED COMPENSATION THAT IS MAINTAINED BY AN EMPLOYER PRIMARILY FOR THE PURPOSE OF PROVIDING DEFERRED COMPENSATION FOR THE SELECT GROUP OF MANAGEMENT OR HIGHLY COMPENSATED EMPLOYEES AS THOSE TERMS ARE DEFINED UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF THE EMPLOYEE RETIREMENT INCOME SECURITY ACT OF 1974, AS AMENDED (ERISA). FUNDING FOR THIS PLAN IS THROUGH ANNUAL EMPLOYER CONTRIBUTIONS AND IS LIMITED TO THE ANNUAL AMOUNT SET FORTH BY THE US TREASURY DEPARTMENT. SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 1A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL CONSIST OF THE OFFICERS OF THE ASSOCIATION, AND, IN ITS DISCRETION, A MAJORITY OF THE DIRECTORS THEN IN OFFICE MAY APPOINT ONE ADDITIONAL DIRECTOR TO THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE FOR A TERM OF ONE YEAR. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL HAVE THE AUTHORITY TO ACT BETWEEN REGULAR OR SPECIAL MEETINGS OF THE BOARD, SUBJECT TO THE LIMITATION ON POWERS OF BOARD COMMITTEES SET FORTH BY THE BYLAWS. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL SERVE IN A LIAISON CAPACITY WITH SIMILAR COMMITTEES OF OTHER PROFESSIONAL ORGANIZATIONS IN THE HEALTHCARE FIELD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE MEMBERSHIP HAS FOUR CLASSES OF MEMBERS: PRIMARY CARE PROVIDER MEMBERS (VOTING), RELATED PROVIDER MEMBERS (VOTING), CONSTITUENT MEMBERS (NONVOTING) AND ASSOCIATE MEMBERS (NONVOTING).

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MEMBERSHIP ELECTS THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND OFFICERS EXCEPT THE EX-OFFICIO BOARD POSITIONS AS NAMED IN THE BYLAWS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY COVERS EACH MEMBER OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS; THE PRESIDENT/CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER; CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER; KEY EMPLOYEES; ANY PERSON WHO HAS HELD ONE OF THOSE POSITIONS DURING THE PRECEDING FIVE YEARS; FAMILY MEMBERS; AND CERTAIN CONTROLLED ORGANIZATIONS (INTERESTED PERSONS). ALL INTERESTED PERSONS ANNUALLY SIGN A STATEMENT THAT AFFIRMS RECEIPT AND AGREEMENT TO COMPLY WITH THE POLICY AND TO DISCLOSE ANY FINANCIAL INTERESTS OR FAMILY RELATIONSHIPS THAT COULD GIVE RISE TO A CONFLICT OF INTEREST. EACH INTERESTED PERSON IS REQUIRED TO DISCLOSE TO THE BOARD (OR COMMITTEE THEREOF), ALL MATERIAL FACTS REGARDING THE FINANCIAL INTEREST OR RELATIONSHIP IN THE TRANSACTION. WITH REGARD TO AN INTERESTED PERSON, THE BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES IF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST EXISTS. THE INSIDER(S) INVOLVED WITH THE TRANSACTION WILL NOT BE PRESENT DURING THE BOARD OR COMMITTEE'S DISCUSSION OR DETERMINATION OF WHETHER A CONFLICT OF INTEREST EXISTS, AND MAY NOT VOTE ON THE TRANSACTION OR BE COUNTED IN DETERMINATION OF A QUORUM. ALL PROCEEDINGS ARE DOCUMENTED IN MEETING MINUTES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AN OUTSIDE COMPENSATION CONSULTING FIRM PROVIDED AN OPINION ON PRESIDENT/CEO COMPENSATION IN THE YEAR OF HIRE, AND INDEPENDENT SALARY SURVEYS ARE USED TO BENCHMARK SALARIES OF CEOS AND SELECTED KEY EXECUTIVES ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. THE INFORMATION FOR THE CEO IS REVIEWED BY THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE AND THEN APPROVED BY THE FULL BOARD OF TRUSTEES ANNUALLY. COMPENSATION FOR OTHER OFFICERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES IS DETERMINED BY MANAGEMENT, APPROVED BY THE FULL BOARD OF TRUSTEES THROUGH THE ANNUAL BUDGETING PROCESS, AND IS DOCUMENTED IN MEETING MINUTES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE NOT AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC.
